text: In a place like this! Mercy on us, who is she!” “I am Mary Lennox,” the little girl said, drawing herself up stiffly. She thought the man was very rude to call her father’s bungalow “A place like this!” “I fell asleep when everyone had the cholera and I have only just wakened up. Why does nobody come?” “It is the child no one ever saw!” exclaimed the man, turning to his companions. “She has actually been forgotten!” “Why was I forgotten?” Mary said, stamping her foot.
